items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: You know a saxophone player by the name of Jerry Jerome?

ctx.x: And actually, Herschel was dying then. He hadn't died. I think he died maybe within a week or three or four days or something like that because he was sick. I understand his legs had swollen all up. He had heart trouble and they called it dropsy and stuff. You know a saxophone player by the name of Jerry Jerome?
